qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Leading oncology and rare disease patent estate, but 5-year median GAAP ROIC is sub-hurdle (~9-10%), and pricing power is severely curtailed by US IRA Medicare price negotiations (Farxiga), European single-payer price caps, and late-decade patent expirations.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & Pricing Power, REJECT). Premier oncology innovator, but multi-year GAAP ROIC averages ~9-10% (diluted by the $39B Alexion buyout) and pricing power faces severe headwinds from US IRA Medicare price cuts (Farxiga), European healthcare budget freezes, and upcoming patent cliffs.
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC hovered between 4% and 12% from 2022 to 2024, with 5-year median ROIC failing the 12% threshold. Pricing power is actively constrained by legislative price caps (IRA Farxiga price cuts), European cost-containment, and upcoming loss of exclusivity on key franchise blockbusters.
